Description.SourceString:
Whereas the KotHaar-Hur are beasts of burden to the KotHaar community, the KotHaar-Ket are builders, crafters and warriors. They wield great obsidian hammers to shatter rock, pummel stone into shape and to crack the skulls of any foolish creature that might think to endanger KotHaar society.

When Fuzan’s power seized control of these creatures, he focused only on their violent role. The dragon delights in watching these hammers smash the bones of any that might stand against him. He has no plan to build cities. No desire to craft wonders. He seeks only to rend everything down to dust, so that his sands might bury the world.
